nodes.notes: Body: plate, kind (blocking|lights_on|towing|window_open|accident|other), lang, couriers: [{name, signal}] in the order they pass the sender.

Should it be carried first because the owner must act within minutes (towing, accident, theft)?' } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', temperature: 0.2, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Write ONE short sentence for a car owner: someone nearby reports about car ' + $json.plate + ': ' + $json.kind.replace('_',' ') + '. nodes.name: Deliver live?
nodes.notes: Only when the request says deliver:true and a carrier had a signal. Off by default so the public demo URL cannot raise alerts on real cars.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ action: 'alert', code: ($json.body && $json.body.code) || '', plate_last4: $('Encode the Bluetooth advert').item.json.plate_last4, kind: $('Encode the Bluetooth advert').item.json.kind, lang: $('Encode the Bluetooth advert').item.json.lang, ref: $('Encode the Bluetooth advert').item.json.ref, via: 'sound' }) }}

nodes.notes: Same call as AppState.deliverWhisper. The ref makes the server accept it once however many phones deliver it.
